title: Bluegate Business Storage Account Enrolment Requirements by Program
content:
Enrolment in any program of the Bluegate Business Storage Account is open to business profiles only. What an application must bring, whether a credit review is part of it and how many active storage or parking agreements the business must hold differ by program.

## Requirements matrix

| Program | Active storage or parking agreements the business must hold to keep the program | Credit review required at application | Documents required to open the account |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | 1 | No | EIN letter or W-9 |
| Bluegate Business Plus | 1 | No | EIN letter or W-9 |
| Bluegate Business Pro | 2 | Yes | EIN letter or W-9; business license |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | 2 | Yes | EIN letter or W-9; business license; certificate of insurance |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | 3 | Yes | EIN letter or W-9; business license; fleet list |
| Bluegate Business National Account | 10 | Yes | EIN letter or W-9; business license; certificate of insurance; credit application |

## Observations drawn from the matrix

- Every program requires an EIN letter or W-9. Pro and every program above it also require a business license.
- Logistics and National Account require a certificate of insurance; Fleet does not, but requires a fleet list instead. Only National Account requires a credit application.
- Essentials and Plus need no credit review and 1 agreement. Pro and Logistics need a credit review and 2 agreements. Fleet needs a credit review and 3 agreements; National Account a credit review and 10 agreements.

## Hypothetical comparison

*Hypothetical business, for illustration only:* a business profile holding 2 active agreements and able to supply an EIN letter and a business license, with no certificate of insurance and no fleet list.

| Program | Agreements (2 held) | Documents | Credit review |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | Meets 1 | Meets | Not required |
| Bluegate Business Plus | Meets 1 | Meets | Not required |
| Bluegate Business Pro | Meets 2 | Meets | Required |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | Meets 2 | Lacks certificate of insurance | Required |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | Short of 3 | Lacks fleet list | Required |
| Bluegate Business National Account | Short of 10 | Lacks certificate of insurance and credit application | Required |
